newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA NEWS HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA NEWS HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea met an International Monetary Fund mission led by the IMF's chief negotiator for Romania, Poul Thomsen.
The IMF team will assess restructuring and privatisation steps taken by the government in line with pledges under a loan accord expected to be debated by the Fund on April 23.
Finance Minister Mircea Ciumara and central bank governor Mugur Isarescu attended the talks.
* Lower Chamber of Deputies rejected an amendment to postpone an April 30 deadline for the country's five Private Ownership Funds to turn into investment companies.
* Workers at the Brasov-based state-run truck manufacturer Roman SA are demonstrating in the city's centre to protest over bad management and planned restructuring of the company.
They demanded that a government team be sent to Brasov.
* A delegation of government officials and State Ownership Fund representatives left for Brasov to talk with the Roman SA protesters.
* Some 30 illegal Romanian immigrants were expelled from France on Tuesday. Three of them had been detained for threatening public order.
* Upper Senate's defence commission met American analyst Todd Roy to discuss the status of Romania's spying services and the civil society's control of over those institutions.
